rule: A development-only contract variant is a registered, versioned policy (OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-03 section 1; OWNER-GRAPHITE-DEV-LEVELS-01). A new variant is a new document <version>.json in this directory plus its pinned digest in versions; making it the variant a (challenge, level) runs under is a change to current. A version, once registered, is never removed or re-pinned, so every miner-facing door keeps refusing it by name. Real Level 1-3 surfaces are added only after the Test Lead reviews them; no fixture variant is ever registered here.
